text:
deploybot: Automatic pause: rollout v2.17.0 (slot 58) quarantined due to repeated 502/503s observed in EU control-plane health checks. Quarantine engaged 22:05 UTC.
cam: ack. how widespread? which AZs/percent?
jordan: errors concentrated in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1, roughly 9% of eu traffic. traces show token fetch timeouts amplifying existing retries.
ops-oncall: investigating. token-service TLS renegotiation errors seen on proxy logs after a cert rotation. ETA 20m for rollback of rotation or mitigation.
nia: please do NOT auto-rollback the app. pin the release and reschedule remaining slots. we don't want half-rollouts.
deploy-admin: pinning now: `deployctl pin --service inference-api --version v2.17.0 --slot 58 --reason "INC-8688 token-cert"`
deploybot: Pin recorded. slot 58 quarantined; subsequent slots paused. Canary traffic re-routed to stable variant.
release-manager: drafting a short internal note and customer blurb in status page. link incident INC-8688. assign owners for followups.
sre-lead: preparing rollback command and hotfix branch in parallel in case we find app regressions. hotfix branch: `hotfix/cert-backoff-2026-03-21`.
jordan: rollback command (dry-run ready):
```
# rollback to v2.16.12
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from-version v2.17.0 --to-version v2.16.12 --reason "INC-8688"
```
ops-oncall: mitigation plan: revert cert rotation on token-proxy and restart proxy pods. staging test passed. applying now. monitoring.
incident-bot: INC-8688 updated: token-proxy cert rotation reverted; proxy restarts in progress. next update 10m.
cam: if ops confirms it's proxy-only, plan is to keep pin and reschedule the rollout to the next low-traffic window. what's next available window?
release-manager: nearest maintenance window is 2026-03-22 00:00-03:00 UTC. proposed: reschedule remaining slots to 2026-03-22T00:45:00Z, with a 3% targeted micro-canary at 00:30 UTC. leave slot 58 quarantined until post-canary verification.
ops-oncall: metrics trending towards baseline. baseline error rate restored in last 6m. recommend keeping pin and running the 3% micro-canary as suggested. do not auto-unquarantine slot 58.
deploy-admin: annotated deploy ticket with reschedule details and added tag `hold/INC-8688`. owners: @nia for canary checks, @jordan for rollback readiness, @cam for customer comms.
nia: will run smoke tests before micro-canary and post results here. if any regressions show, we execute rollback per above.
sre-lead: hotfix branch built and smoke-tested in staging. rollback dry-run succeeded with no DB migration steps.
release-manager: drafting customer-facing blurb: "Planned rollout delayed for EU regions due to control-plane token-proxy incident (INC-8688). We will run a small verification canary at 00:30 UTC and resume the rollout at 00:45 UTC pending verification." queueing for PM approval.
ops-oncall: final confirm: token-proxy restarts complete, error rate stable for 12m. go/no-go will be 00:15 UTC for the 00:30 micro-canary.
deploybot: Noted. Next attempt for slot 59 moved to 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z (3% micro-canary). slot 58 remains quarantined.
cam: please also add a short postmortem bullet to the release doc: what happened, reasoning to pin, rollback readiness, reschedule plan, owners. release-manager can merge after canary pass.
release-manager: will include postmortem bullet and close after successful canary. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
